Tarikh | Episode 1057 | 08 Sept 2025
In this episode of Tarikh :
India’s history is not of a single culture or empire, but a tapestry woven through centuries of dynasties, invasions, and resilience. From the Mauryas to the British, different rulers shaped the subcontinent, each leaving behind both glory and scars.
we revisit five greatest empires that ruled the largest parts of India across 2500 years:
• Maurya Empire – Ashoka, Chanakya, and the world’s first lessons in governance and peace.
• Gupta Empire – India’s Golden Age of art, science, and literature.
